issue.body:
### Describe the feature

The `retry`, `retryDelay`, `retryStatusCodes` options allow to retry requests when the server have responded with certain status codes.
It should be also possible to **retry when the request failed on the client side**, for network reason for example.

Here a few possibilities :
- We could support the `null` value in retryStatusCodes, it would mean retry when no status code ie when no response.
- We could add option flags `retryOnNetworkError: boolean` or  `retryOnClientError: boolean` or `retryOnResponseNull: boolean`
- We could add an option `retryOnError: boolean|ErrorConstructor|ErrorConstructor[]` which could be either a boolean (allErrors) or a list of Error classes to retry on (ex: `retryOnError: NetworkError`)
- We could expose a `retry(delay?: number)` method which could be called in error handler

### Additional information

- [x] Would you be willing to help implement this feature?

issue.title: feat: enhance retry system with attempt tracking, retryCondition, and onRetry hook

repository.name: ofetch
repository.description: 😱 A better fetch API. Works everywhere.

issue.body:
## Summary

- Add `FetchRetryState` (`{ attempt, limit }`) to `FetchContext` for retry tracking
- Add `retryCondition` option for custom retry logic beyond status codes
- Add `onRetry` hook called before each retry (e.g., token refresh)
- Fix retry not checking custom `retryStatusCodes` for client errors

## Changes

### `src/types.ts`
- New `FetchRetryState` interface with `attempt` and `limit` fields
- `retryCondition` option: `(context) => boolean | Promise<boolean>`
- `onRetry` hook in `FetchHooks`

### `src/fetch.ts`
- Retry state tracking via `FetchRetryState` instead of decrementing `retry` count
- `retryCondition` evaluated alongside `retryStatusCodes` (retries if **either** matches)
- `onRetry` hook called before each retry with full context
- `retryDelay` callback now receives context with retry state

### Usage examples

```ts
// Exponential backoff with attempt tracking
await $fetch('/api', {
  retry: 3,
  retryDelay(ctx) {
    return Math.pow(2, ctx.retry.attempt) * 1000
  },
})

// Custom retry condition
await $fetch('/api', {
  retry: 3,
  retryCondition(ctx) {
    return ctx.response?.headers.get('x-retry') === 'true'
  },
})

// Token refresh on retry
await $fetch('/api', {
  retry: 1,
  retryStatusCodes: [401],
  async onRetry(ctx) {
    const token = await refreshToken()
    ctx.options.headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`)
  },
})
```

## Test plan

- [x] Retry state exposed in `onResponseError` context
- [x] Retry state exposed in `retryDelay` callback
- [x] `retryCondition` callback triggers retry
- [x] `retryCondition` works alongside `retryStatusCodes`
- [x] `onRetry` hook called with correct attempt/limit
- [x] `onRetry` can modify request options (token refresh)
- [x] Abort signal prevents retry even with `retryCondition`
- [x] `retryCondition` receives error context for network failures
- [x] Type tests for `FetchRetryState`, `retryCondition`, `onRetry`
- [x] All existing tests pass (36 + 6 type tests)
- [x] Lint, typecheck, build pass

Resolves #536, #503, #358, #495

issue.body:
## Why

Retry is the single most-requested feature across competitors. ofetch's current retry is hardcoded (3 attempts, fixed status list). Users want full programmatic control.

## Evidence
- ofetch [#355](https://github.com/unjs/ofetch/issues/355) (23 reactions, 5 comments) — \"Ability to retry a request after an error\".
- ofetch [#503](https://github.com/unjs/ofetch/issues/503) — \"Custom retry logic\".
- ofetch [#358](https://github.com/unjs/ofetch/issues/358) — \"feat: support callback for retry option\".
- ofetch [#495](https://github.com/unjs/ofetch/issues/495) — \"Client errors are not retried when 500 is not included in retryStatusCodes\".
- ky [#848](https://github.com/sindresorhus/ky/pull/848) — \"Add \`totalTimeout\` option and make \`timeout\` be per retry\".
- ky [#842](https://github.com/sindresorhus/ky/pull/842) — \"Add \`NetworkError\` class and tighten retry logic\".
- got [#2388](https://github.com/sindresorhus/got/pull/2388) — \"correct support for AbortSignal:timeout()\".

## Proposed API

\`\`\`ts
retry: {
  limit?: number | (ctx) => number
  delay?: number | (ctx) => number       // exponential by default
  statusCodes?: number[]                 // 408 413 429 500 502 503 504
  methods?: HttpMethod[]                 // safe methods only by default
  shouldRetry?: (ctx, error) => boolean  // ultimate escape hatch
  onRetry?: (ctx, error) => void | Promise<void>
}
\`\`\`

Plus a \`NetworkError\` class distinct from \`HTTPError\` (TCP/DNS/abort vs. HTTP 4xx/5xx) so user code can pattern-match.

## Out of scope
\`Retry-After\` header parsing handled internally; document the precedence.
